Title: Privileged analytics report lacks in-handler admin authorization
Evidence: analytics-report uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and selects analytics_events; no user/admin guard in handler; deployed JWT configuration unavailable
Reproduction: Static: inspect supabase/functions/analytics-report/index.ts; do not probe production without authorization
Business impact: Potential exposure of analytics metadata and event records if endpoint is reachable to non-admin callers
Root cause: Privileged service-role client is used without an explicit server-side role check
Recommended fix: Require authenticated admin authorization in handler and return only required fields; test anon/non-admin denial
Dependencies: Supabase project settings and authorized test account
Verification: Deploy to staging; verify 401/403 for anonymous and non-admin callers and least-privilege response for admins

Title: Localized India pages return 404 and are absent from live sitemap
Evidence: Live URLs /india-tours/de/, /fr/, /nl/ returned 404; live india-tours-pages.xml lists English hub only; production validator reports three missing routes
Reproduction: GET each live locale URL and fetch published India-tour sitemap
Affected scope: German, French, Dutch India-tour landing pages
Business impact: European organic visitors cannot reach proposed market pages; hreflang targets are not live
Root cause: Local implementation has not been deployed/published
Recommended fix: Deploy approved pages and regenerate sitemap; verify HTTP 200, self-canonical, reciprocal hreflang and sitemap presence
Dependencies: Business launch approval and native-language review
Verification: Run production validator and URL Inspection after release
Status: Confirmed current deployment state; rollout expectation to confirm

Title: India tours header overflows narrow mobile viewport
Evidence: Local browser at 320px: document scrollWidth 346px; header controls extend beyond viewport; 360px also reports overflow
Reproduction: Open local /india-tours/ and set viewport to 320px and 360px
Business impact: Header controls can be clipped and page can scroll horizontally
Root cause: Header logo and fixed-width control group do not fit the narrow flex row
Recommended fix: Allow controls to wrap/reflow or simplify the narrow header layout
Verification: Repeat viewport checks at 320px/360px and verify no document overflow

Title: Newsletter email is persisted and logged as analytics metadata
Evidence: Newsletter.tsx calls newsletterSignup(email); analytics.ts sends {email} to analytics_events and logs metadata
Reproduction: Static trace from newsletter submit to analytics helper; no real email submitted
Business impact: Direct identifier is retained in analytics and browser logs; increases privacy exposure
Root cause: Analytics helper accepts and propagates personal data
Recommended fix: Remove email and identifiers from analytics payload/logs; review retention and privacy notice
Verification: Test with synthetic email and assert analytics payload/logs contain no direct identifiers

Title: Newsletter success state does not confirm a subscription
Evidence: Newsletter opens mailto draft then immediately sets subscribed=true and shows welcome-email claim; no backend result is handled
Reproduction: Submit a synthetic address locally and observe state transition; do not send the mail
Business impact: Visitors may believe they are subscribed when nothing was sent or stored
Root cause: mailto handoff is treated as successful server subscription
Recommended fix: Implement an approved subscription backend with result states or accurately label the mail draft flow
Verification: Test valid/invalid input, backend success/failure, duplicate submissions, and confirmation

Title: Project lint baseline fails
Evidence: npm run lint exited 1 with 243 errors and 26 warnings across src and Supabase functions
Business impact: Lint cannot gate regressions; defects/noise can mask new issues
Root cause: Existing unused variables, explicit any, switch-case declaration and other rule violations
Recommended fix: Triage errors by changed/critical paths, fix in batches, and establish lint gate
Verification: npm run lint exits 0 without disabling rules wholesale

Title: Standalone TypeScript checks fail
Evidence: tsc -b reports syntax errors in two tracked src/components/pages files; tsconfig.node reports missing Node built-in/global typings
Reproduction: Run npx tsc -b --pretty false and npx tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false
Affected scope: Unreferenced TSX files and Vite config typecheck
Business impact: Vite build can pass while invalid/unreferenced TypeScript and configuration remain unchecked
Root cause: Vite build transpiles without a typecheck; malformed TSX files are included by tsconfig.app; Node types absent
Recommended fix: Restore valid source in malformed tracked files; define supported app/node typecheck projects and add matching Node typings
Dependencies: Confirm expected contents of malformed source files
Verification: Both TypeScript project checks pass and remain in CI

Title: Development toolchain has npm audit advisories
Evidence: Full npm audit: 15 findings (11 high, 3 moderate, 1 low); production-only audit: zero; forced fix implies Tailwind major 4
Reproduction: Run npm audit --audit-level=high and npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
Business impact: Potential tooling and local dev-server exposure; no production dependency finding in this audit
Root cause: Transitive dependency versions fall within advisory ranges
Recommended fix: Review lockfile paths and non-breaking updates; schedule major Tailwind migration separately; do not force-fix blindly
Dependencies: Regression suite and Tailwind compatibility review
Verification: Re-run full and production npm audits; build/test and verify dev-server behavior

Title: Privacy notice may not describe current processing
Evidence: Privacy page says last updated January 1, 2025; analytics currently stores event metadata and newsletter email
Reproduction: Compare current privacy notice with implemented data flows and retention
Business impact: Users may not get clear/current information about processing
Root cause: Notice has a stale date and broad generic wording
Recommended fix: Have qualified privacy counsel review purposes, processors, legal basis, retention, rights and consent requirements
Verification: Document approved notice and verify implementation matches it
